game.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 + 2
game.blurb: Arcade skateboarding game, a remake of the first two Tony Hawk's Pro Skater games, from Vicarious Visions and Iron Galaxy Studios, released 2020-09-04. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours. Genres: Sports, Arcade. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: THPS1 Classic
chapters.summary: Unlocking parks and completing every goal with gold medals in the first game's career.

chapters.title: THPS2 Classic
chapters.summary: Unlocking School II and Bullring and completing every goal with gold medals in the second game's career.

chapters.title: Tours and Competition Medals
chapters.summary: Earning medals on the competition parks in Tours.

chapters.title: Challenges, Career Level and the Skate Shop
chapters.summary: The Rookie, Veteran and Legend challenge collections, hard Get-Theres, career levels 10 and 100, and spending in the Skate Shop.

chapters.title: Plushies, Stat Points and Gaps
chapters.summary: Finding every alien plushie and stat point, and completing the gap collections.

chapters.title: Big Scores and Combos
chapters.summary: 50,000 and 1,000,000 point combos and record high scores.

chapters.title: Create-A-Skater and Create-A-Park
chapters.summary: Making a skater, building and uploading a park, and placing 500 objects.

chapters.title: Multiplayer and Other Modes
chapters.summary: Multiplayer matches, Graffiti, Horse, Trick Attack and Combo Mambo.

chapters.title: Secret Achievements
chapters.summary: Seven achievements Steam keeps secret. Spoiler-guarded.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). This is the 2020 remake; it uses its own Steam app 2395210 ("Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 1 + 2"; the schema calls it "Firewalker", an internal codename). StrategyWiki has a stub page "Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 + 2" (completion stage 0, marked as a stub); only its "Achievements and trophies", "Controls" and "Table of Contents" subpages are written. The contents page links a Walkthrough and 19 park pages (Warehouse to Skate Heaven), none written, so nothing was used. tonyhawk.fandom.com answers the API under "Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 + 2" with about 98 linked articles (skaters, parks, Create-A-Park, Gaps, Challenges); names only were looked at, nothing copied (tonyhawkspro-skater.fandom.com returned HTTP 404). 7 of 36 Steam achievements are hidden and have their own chapter; two of their API names (ACH_UNLOCK_ROSWELL and ACH_COLLIDE_BULL) suggest the Roswell and Bullring parks, but they were left in the secrets chapter. Which game the alien plushies belong to is not said, so they sit in the collectibles chapter. RAWG's playtime of 2 hours looks low.
